question: After an observed contradiction, can a cold native model expand its representation, preserve exactly its actually witnessed knowledge without old raw rows, and learn the previously rejected observations? Does that recover unseen-family predictions or only observed knowledge?
known_failure: CKAD06 degree3 inferred354 false held answers; CKAD07 quarantines12 incompatible addresses and preserves55296 compatible held answers. All outcomes remain frozen. This is post-result engineering repair, NOT a new confirmatory benchmark or synthetic threshold search.

inputs.checkpoints: all3 committed CKAD07 guarded16-address bundles; hashes from CKAD07/result.json
inputs.affected: Only addresses whose frozen guard has observed contradiction pins;12 total. No family or held-answer selection.
inputs.old_witnesses: 128 actually observed input/action pairs per affected address; labels recovered ONLY from native coefficients at the observed-input bitset. Old raw outcome rows may be used by evaluator/control to VERIFY, never passed to repair.
inputs.new_batches: Exact original rejected rows128:256 followed by rows256:512 from unchanged pinned CKAD02 dataset;2 packets,128+256 effects. First packet pin MUST equal frozen contradiction pin before quarantine can clear.

implementation.method: Explicit immutable repair function takes pinned guarded checkpoint, address, declared wider degree and hash-pinned admitted batches. Reconstruct labels ONLY for prior observed inputs, rebuild generic native GF2 constraints in expanded basis, keep old source ledger/count/input masks, then stage new evidence. Clear only that address quarantine AFTER the exact rejected batch has been admitted and all batches fit. Return new guarded checkpoint plus before/after provenance receipt. Old checkpoint remains byte exact.
implementation.basis: Widest generic complete degree11 first and ONLY; no source family template, sparse prior, capacity sweep or post-result tuning. Context remains10 binary observed inputs +1 action. Generic degree expansion API accepts only strict increases <=11.
implementation.why_witness_only: Old support equations and unobserved logical predictions depend on the disproved degree3 assumption. They must NOT be treated as witnessed facts in the richer class. The observed-input bitset separates true training witnesses from derived forecasts.
implementation.capacity: Existing16 slots,4096 observations/address,64 source batches,10MiB bound; no original source mode. Existing accumulator/quarantine modules and checkpoint formats unchanged.

controls.full_native: Reuse exact frozen CKAD06 degree11 checkpoint for each affected source, same512 effects. Compare every2048 prediction, not just score. No repeat full fitting benchmark.
controls.independent_symbolic: Reuse qualified CKAD06 degree11 independent symbolic parity/result as equally informed exact control; repair must match the full native control which was independently qualified. No unique numerical advantage claim.
controls.conventional: Reuse fully trained CART512 exact same-source qualified receipts, no retraining. Report broad held65364 correct/8364 wrong; no current compute equality claim.
controls.no_old_memory_ablation: Fresh complete-basis native model sees only the same384 newly delivered effects. Evaluate previous128 observed consequences; it should abstain there. This ablation has less retained information and is NOT presented as strongest control.
controls.quarantine_predecessor: Frozen CKAD07 aborts readout for all affected inputs. Retain its exact benchmark outputs; do not rewrite the354 old errors.

evaluation.observed: For each12 affected addresses, query all512 original TRAIN input/action pairs. Check1536 earlier witnessed consequences retained and4608 newly admitted effects correct;6144 observed answers recovered from quarantine.
evaluation.unseen: Original1536 held combinations per address,73728 total acrossall48 relationships. Expected complete basis still abstains on18432 affected held queries and preserves55296 compatible correct answers. Zero recovered unseen-family answers is recorded as a substantive limit, not called a science success.
evaluation.cold: Fresh process receives ONLY repaired checkpoint bytes plus numeric queries, no source generator/evaluator labels; all16x2048 readouts perseed match,98304 total. Then checkpoint corruption, source-kind/pin, missing rejected packet, no-class-drift and unaffected active/retained bytes tested.
evaluation.preset_engineering_pass: All6144 observed answers correct,1536 recovered native old witnesses match exact source, no old raw rows delivered to repair; all unaffected36 profiles/ledgers/flags byte exact; every2048 output at each affected address equals cached complete-basis native control; fresh no-memory ablation answers0/1536 old witnesses; zero held errors and55296 retained compatible answers; exact cross-OS stable result.
evaluation.classification: WITNESS_PRESERVING_REPRESENTATION_REPAIR_SUPPORTED if engineering invariants pass. UNFAMILIAR_FAMILY_RECOVERY_NO_GO if no affected held answers recovered. Both classifications may coexist and must be reported.
evaluation.retuning: No new fresh data split, threshold/degree choice, source scan or previously scored benchmark optimization.
